item.title: Bonnie OBrien
item.description:
Bonnie OBrien

Director of Human Resources

Email: bobrien@iq.harvard.edu

Bonnie O’Brien joined IQSS in 2012 and is currently the Director of Human Resources. She provides overall HR leadership and support in the areas of recruitment and retention, employee relations, organizational and policy development, performance management, and oversees academic personnel. Before Harvard, she worked at UC San Diego in a similar HR role. She holds a bachelors degree in liberal arts, a Human Resources Management certificate from UCSD, a Senior Professional in Human Resources (SPHR) certification, and has 20 years of comprehensive HR experience, over 15 of those in higher education. She is currently enrolled in a Master’s program for Industrial-Organizational Psychology.

item.title: Brooke Moore
item.description:
Brooke Moore

Director of Sponsored Research Administration

Email: bmoore@iq.harvard.edu

Brooke joined the finance team at IQSS in 2014 and is currently the Director of Sponsored Research Administration. At IQSS, Brooke manages the sponsored research team and overall program. She is responsible for overseeing the financial management and research compliance of the sponsored research portfolio and providing pre-award support as needed. Brooke is also the administrative lead on several of IQSS’s scientific research programs.

item.title: Ceilyn Boyd
item.description:
Ceilyn Boyd

Interim Director of Data Science and Product Research

Email: cboyd@iq.harvard.edu

Ceilyn Boyd is the Dataverse Development Project Manager at Harvard University’s Institute for Quantitative Social Sciences (IQSS), overseeing the software development process to ensure the team meets its project, partnership, and grant responsibilities.

Previously, Boyd established and led the Harvard Library Research Data Services Program, which connects the Harvard community to resources and services throughout the research data lifecycle. Additional work at Harvard Library included taxonomy development, management of large-scale manuscript digitization projects, oversight of library collections as data initiatives, and leadership of major cross-organization strategic portfolios.

item.title: Debi Kleiman
item.description:
Debi Kleiman

Director, IQSS Startup Foundry

Email: dkleiman@iq.harvard.edu

Debi Kleiman leads the IQSS Startup Foundry at Harvard, where she catalyzes faculty-led innovation and commercialization across the University.

Her distinguished career includes leadership roles at Harvard Business School’s D^3 Startup Foundry and The Players Impact, where she directed an accelerator for elite athlete entrepreneurs, and as Managing Partner and founder of The Upside Angels. Prior to Harvard, Debi served as Executive Director of Babson College’s Blank Center for Entrepreneurship while also teaching entrepreneurship as an adjunct professor.

item.title: Elizabeth Jackson
item.description:
Elizabeth Jackson

Executive Director of IQSS

Email: ejackson@iq.harvard.edu

Elizabeth Jackson is the Executive Director of IQSS. Elizabeth joined IQSS in July 2022 from both Greater Portland Health in Maine, and the Department of Global Health and Population at the Harvard TH Chan School of Public Health. Elizabeth has dedicated her career to work in alignment with the mission of IQSS. She served most recently as the Chief Administrative Officer of Greater Portland Health, has provided health system and community strengthening efforts with partners in Africa, Asia, and Latin America, and has led trauma-informed resilience trainings. Elizabeth has developed, implemented, and overseen health and education programs in several academic, community, public sector, and health settings. She has also previously worked at the World Health Organization, the Yale Global Health Leadership Institute, and the Harvard Global Health Institute. Elizabeth received her Masters in Public Health from Yale University and her Bachelors from Bates College.

item.title: Gary King
item.description:
Gary King

Director of IQSS; Albert J. Weatherhead III University Professor

Email: king@harvard.edu

Gary King is the Albert J. Weatherhead III University Professor at Harvard University – one of 22 with the title of University Professor, Harvard’s most distinguished faculty position. He is based in the Department of Government (in the Faculty of Arts and Sciences) and serves as Director of the Institute for Quantitative Social Science. King develops and applies empirical methods in many areas of social science research, focusing on innovations that span the range from statistical theory to practical application.

item.title: Glen Comiso
item.description:
Glen Comiso

Executive Director, Human Flourishing Program

Email: gcomiso@fas.harvard.edu

Glen Comiso is the Executive Director of the Human Flourishing Program at Harvard University’s Institute for Quantitative Social Science (IQSS). In this role, Glen oversees all aspects of the program’s strategic vision, donor relations, external partnerships, day-to-day operations, and program leadership. He has extensive experience building organizations, policies and programs at the intersection of academia, government, and industry.

item.title: Jason Nemirow
item.description:
Jason Nemirow

Director, Program on Higher Education Research

Email: nemirow@fas.harvard.edu

Jason Nemirow is the director of the Program on Higher Education Research (PHER) at IQSS. In this role, he leads the program’s strategic development and research agenda, manages donor and partner engagement, and oversees operations and initiatives that advance the study of higher education through rigorous social science methods.

He is also the director of the Council for Academic Freedom at Harvard (CAFH), a 200+ member faculty association housed within PHER—all under the administrative umbrella of IQSS.

item.title: Len Wisniewski
item.description:
Len Wisniewski

Senior Director of Research Computing

Email: lwisniewski@iq.harvard.edu

Len Wisniewski is Senior Director of Research Computing at IQSS. Before IQSS, Len was Engineering Manager for the High Performance Computing group at Sun Microsystems, leading the teams developing the Sun HPC ClusterTools and Sun Studio Performance Analyzer products. In that role, he actively supported the Open MPI open-source community. Before entering a management role, Len held software engineering roles at various companies, including Sun/Oracle, Acopia Networks (acquired by F5 Networks), and Thinking Machines (acquired by Sun). His primary technical interests have been in developing algorithms and file systems for parallel and distributed computers.

item.title: Rachel Franklin
item.description:
Rachel Franklin

Executive Director, Center for Geographic Analysis

Email: rachel_franklin@cga.harvard.edu

Dr. Rachel Franklin started as Executive Director of the CGA in March of 2025, bringing more than 20 years’ experience as an educator and researcher in GIS, spatial analysis, and quantitative methods. Her research interests are in the sources and impacts of demographic change as it occurs at multiple spatial scales, and in the use of novel forms of data and analysis to identify and address that change. Her most recent research explores how smart city technologies contribute to and reinforce socio-economic and spatial inequalities.

item.title: Steven Worthington
item.description:
Steven Worthington

Director of Data Science Services

Email: sworthington@iq.harvard.edu

Steve has worked at IQSS since 2011. He earned a PhD in Biological Anthropology from New York University and is working on a master’s in data science at Harvard. He hails from northern England, but has lived in New York and Helsinki, Finland. During his graduate studies, he developed an interest in computational biology and statistical programming using R and Python. His expertise spans Bayesian and frequentist inference, deep learning, phylogenetic methods, and geometric morphometrics. In his free time, he enjoys playing with his dog, Beckett, and indulging his interest in photography.

item.title: Valerie OKane
item.description:
Valerie OKane

Director of Business Operations

Email: valerie_okane@harvard.edu

Valerie O’Kane is the Director of Business Operations at the Institute for Quantitative Social Science (IQSS) at Harvard University with responsibility for the IQSS budget & long term planning, IQSS contract and grant administration, IQSS compliance & space, as well as managing the general day-to-day operations of the IQSS Business Office.

Valerie is a seasoned financial professional who began her career at Harvard in 1992 as a staff assistant in the Central Payroll Office. In 1994 she moved to the FAS Extension School as the Payroll Administrator/Assistant Human Resource Officer. Valerie returned to Harvard Central Administration in 2002 as an accounting assistant and in 2004 became one of two payroll accountants for the University. Valerie was recognized as a Harvard Hero in 2005 as part of the University’s W2 Team. In 2007 she moved to the Harvard Kennedy School as the Financial Manager of the Malcolm Wiener Center for Social Policy.
